Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation

Class Transforms

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation.Transforms
public final class Transforms extends Object
Reusable transform builders compiled into ordinary, conflict-checked property tracks. Matching equations use TokenEquation; replacement transforms crossfade object identities.

    • moveTo

      public static void moveTo(SceneObject object, String anchor, Anchor destination, double start, double duration)
      * Moves an object's selected anchor onto a destination, converting scene space to parent space.
      Parameters:
      object - scene object whose geometry is sampled
      anchor - validated semantic anchor or local anchor name
      destination - destination object or semantic anchor
      start - nonnegative interval start in scene-local seconds (global seconds for audio cues)
      duration - positive interval length in seconds

    • replace

      public static void replace(SceneObject source, SceneObject destination, double start, double duration)
      * Aligns and crossfades source into destination. Source retirement and destination arrival persist.
      Parameters:
      source - source object, matrix row or existing audio file, as described above
      destination - destination object or semantic anchor
      start - nonnegative interval start in scene-local seconds (global seconds for audio cues)
      duration - positive interval length in seconds
